hypothesis.causal_question: Does complete Entity-Memory B retain a retrieval advantage over pure-Memory A when both use the preregistered top_k=50 context budget?
hypothesis.control: Validated v59 A@50 using the exact same Memory text/index and immutable question-vector artifact.
hypothesis.treatment: B@50 adds the complete conversation-extracted Entity graph, 0.30/0.70 Entity/semantic fusion, and sequence expansion while keeping top_k=50.
hypothesis.primary_cutoff: Top_k=25 remains primary; top_k=50 is robustness evidence and will not replace it.
hypothesis.expected_direction: B may retain a retrieval advantage at the larger context budget; preserve favorable, null, or unfavorable results.

budget_rationale.rule: The 6,000,000 ceiling preserves a 15.63% margin over observed matched A@50 usage and 118.65% over B@25; it changes no scientific parameter, cache, prompt, model, metric, or performance gate.
budget_rationale.result_conditioning: No B@50 metric exists before this freeze; the ceiling is based only on prior operational telemetry.
